mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 79 degrees under overcast skies near Verona City Hall. We have a waning crescent moon tonight, and the ISS will be visible at 8:17 PM, tracking from the south southwest over Belleville toward the east northeast near Fitchburg and Madison, rising to about halfway up the sky. Expect an overnight low of 69 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The Verona Fire Department invites everyone to their open house on Saturday, September 19, from 10 am to 2 pm at 101 Lincoln Street. You can tour the station, meet the crew, and learn about fire safety.

Today, you can participate in trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow features a busy lineup including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia and music events throughout the evening.
The Verona Police Department announced that on Sunday, August 30, they arrested a 34-year-old Madison resident for an incident involving a school staff member, which remains an active investigation.
The delicious flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
